# A Study of Unified Body Preparation

The paper studies a complete body preparation pipeline for a reference manager. It keeps every paragraph and the reference section instead of substituting an abstract. The first paragraph is intentionally long enough for the quality gate and for retrieval chunks. A second sentence describes the method and the expected behaviour of the queue.
